title: CoinRun tokenizer quality-first fixed-20k scale sweep
question: At the same 20,000 optimizer updates, how do held-out reconstruction quality and convergence change across the complete five-scale CoinRun tokenizer ladder?
reason: CR-TOK-0002 allocated 62,675 / 9,358 / 2,938 / 2,550 / 2,656 updates as capacity increased. That schedule is useful for compute-efficiency diagnostics but confounds tokenizer capacity with optimization maturity. The n3.7m endpoint already showed a 3.0971 dB online-versus-EMA clean-PSNR gap after only 2,938 updates, so a fixed-update experiment is required before selecting a representation.
hypothesis: With identical data, latent interface, optimizer, loss and 20,000-update horizon, increasing tokenizer backbone capacity beyond n0.17m will improve at least clean, edge or temporal-change held-out reconstruction, and milestone curves will distinguish persistent capacity limits from short-run optimization lag.
falsification: The hypothesis is rejected if none of the four larger scales improves final EMA clean, edge or temporal-change PSNR over n0.17m, or if larger scales fail to produce finite metrics at all four preregistered milestones while retaining the 16-latent by 16-channel interface.

data.policy: Reuse the immutable CR-TOK-0002 structured dataset: 65% goal-directed persistent right/right-jump/no-op macros mixed with 35% balanced persistent macros.

compute.estimated_budget: 100,000 total optimizer updates and approximately 5.506e17 model-estimated FLOPs across the five arms; wall time is expected to be dominated by n8.6m and n16.6m.
compute.shutdown_policy: Use only the existing A10. Maintain a bounded timer beyond the estimated remaining run time, renew only when needed, and stop the instance after terminal artifacts and the ledger are synchronized.

training.checkpoint_policy: Retain exact evaluation steps 2,499 / 4,999 / 9,999 / 19,999, corresponding to 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 completed updates, plus step 14,999 for bounded fault recovery.

evaluation.visual_artifact: one retained reconstruction grid per scale and milestone plus a vertically aligned final-20k comparison grid
evaluation.selection_rule: Descriptive ranking by the unweighted sum of final-20k EMA clean, edge and temporal-change PSNR; no candidate is skipped.

downstream_guard.release_condition: Explicit user visual acceptance of the aligned final-20k grid, followed by a tokenizer-plus-dynamics interface smoke test.

success_criteria.rule: All five arms complete exactly 20,000 optimizer updates from scratch or from fault-only resume, without a scaling helper overriding max_steps.
Every arm produces finite held-out online/EMA clean/masked, edge and temporal-change metrics on the identical 512 clips at 2,500, 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 completed updates.
The final report contains all 20 milestone rows, the complete five-scale final grid and a descriptive ranking with no quality-gate eligibility filter.
Every exact candidate retains n_latents=16 and d_bottleneck=16.
Dynamics remains blocked after technical completion until explicit visual review accepts player outline and platform-edge clarity.
